root.name: アボット・ラボラトリーズ

rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: NVEの大口顧客で、2027年末までの供給パートナー契約を結ぶ
relations.text_en: A major NVE customer under a supplier partnering agreement through 2027

source.label: NVE 10-K(2026年3月期)
source.quote: We have agreements with certain customers, including a Supplier Partnering Agreement, as amended, with Abbott Laboratories, which expires December 31, 2027.

companies.name: イグザクト・サイエンシズ

relations.text: 大腸がん検査のExact Sciencesを買収する合併契約(2025年11月)
relations.text_en: Merger agreement to acquire Exact Sciences (November 2025)

source.label: Exact Sciences 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On November 19, 2025, we entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the "Merger Agreement") with Abbott Laboratories ("Abbott")

companies.name: カーディオバスキュラー・システムズ

source.label: Abbott 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On April 27, 2023, Abbott completed the acquisition of Cardiovascular Systems, Inc.

companies.name: ビッグフット・バイオメディカル

relations.text: 糖尿病管理のつながる仕組みを強化するため2023年9月に買収
relations.text_en: Acquired in September 2023 to build connected diabetes solutions

source.label: Abbott 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On September 22, 2023, Abbott completed the acquisition of Bigfoot, which furthers Abbott's efforts to develop connected solutions for making diabetes management more personal and precise.

companies.name: センセオニクス
companies.sub: 埋め込み型血糖センサー

relations.text: 増資に合わせてアボットが株式を引き受けた
relations.text_en: Abbott bought shares alongside Senseonics' public offering

source.label: Senseonics 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The Company also entered into a securities purchase agreement with Abbott Laboratories ("Abbott") pursuant to which the Company agreed to issue and sell 2,026,963 shares of its common stock substantially concurrently with the Public Offering

relations.text: アボットから分離した医薬品会社(分離契約が続く)
relations.text_en: Pharma business separated from Abbott, under an ongoing separation agreement

source.label: AbbVie 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Subject to certain exceptions specified in the separation agreement by and between Abbott Laboratories (Abbott) and AbbVie

relations.text: DexComが10-Kで、CGMの直接の競合としてアボットの糖尿病部門を挙げる
relations.text_en: DexCom names Abbott's Diabetes Care division as its direct CGM competitor

source.label: DexCom 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In selling our current CGM systems, we compete directly with the Diabetes Care division of Abbott Laboratories;

relations.text: Nevroが10-Kで、主な競合としてMedtronic・Boston Scientificと並べてアボットを挙げる
relations.text_en: Nevro names Abbott among its major competitors with Medtronic and Boston Scientific

source.label: Nevro 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Currently, our major competitors are Medtronic, Boston Scientific and Abbott Laboratories, who have obtained regulatory approval for SCS systems.

relations.text: Artivionが10-Kで、機械弁の主な競合としてアボットを挙げる
relations.text_en: Artivion names Abbott a main competitor in mechanical heart valves

source.label: Artivion 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: On-X heart valves compete primarily with mechanical valves from Abbott Laboratories, Medtronic, plc.

companies.name: アンコール・メディカル

relations.text: Encore MedicalがS-1で、PFO閉鎖デバイスの主な競合としてアボットを挙げる
relations.text_en: Encore Medical names Abbott a primary competitor for PFO devices

source.label: Encore Medical S-1/A(2025年12月)
source.quote: Two of our primary competitors in the U.S. for PFO products are Abbott Laboratories and W.L.

relations.text: InspireMDが10-Kで、頸動脈治療の大手競合の一社としてアボットを挙げる
relations.text_en: InspireMD names Abbott among large competitors in carotid stenting

source.label: InspireMD 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: the manufacturers of products used in connection with CAS procedures include a number of large companies, such as Abbott Laboratories, Boston Scientific Corporation, Medtronic, Cordis Corporation and Terumo Medical Corporation.

relations.text: Glucotrackが10-Kで、競合となる医療機器会社としてアボットを挙げる
relations.text_en: Glucotrack names Abbott among device companies it expects to compete with

source.label: Glucotrack 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Some of the medical device companies that we expect to compete with include Abbott Laboratories, DexCom, Medtronic, and Senseonics.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
